# Spark 4.1.3's REST API, every endpoint, each with booth-spark's decision. Lines are
# "<allow|deny> <path under /api/v1> <where it comes from>". Placeholders in brackets are substituted
# with sample values by TestAllowlist_EveryDocumentedEndpointIsDecided.
#
# "docs": https://spark.apache.org/docs/4.1.3/monitoring.html#rest-api (all 26 endpoints listed there).
# "src": Spark 4.1.3's core/.../status/api/v1/OneApplicationResource.scala and StagesResource.scala,
# which also serve these (the UI's own JavaScript calls them).
allow /version docs
allow /applications docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/jobs docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/jobs/[job-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/stages docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/stages/[stage-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/stages/[stage-id]/[stage-attempt-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/stages/[stage-id]/[stage-attempt-id]/taskSummary docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/stages/[stage-id]/[stage-attempt-id]/taskList docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/executors docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/allexecutors docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/storage/rdd docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/storage/rdd/[rdd-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/environment docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/sql docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/sql/[execution-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/statistics docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/receivers docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/receivers/[stream-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/batches docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/batches/[batch-id] docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/batches/[batch-id]/operations docs
allow /applications/[app-id]/streaming/batches/[batch-id]/operations/[outputOp-id] docs
# Full stack traces of every thread, served even with spark.ui.threadDumpsEnabled=false (step 2).
deny /applications/[app-id]/executors/[executor-id]/threads docs
# The event-log download (a zip of everything the application recorded).
deny /applications/[base-app-id]/logs docs
deny /applications/[base-app-id]/[attempt-id]/logs docs
# The UI's own JavaScript (executorspage.js, stagepage.js).
allow /applications/[app-id] src
allow /applications/[app-id]/allmiscellaneousprocess src
allow /applications/[app-id]/stages/[stage-id]/[stage-attempt-id]/taskTable src
# Every resource again under an attempt id: no attempts exist for a live driver on Kubernetes.
deny /applications/[app-id]/[attempt-id]/jobs src
deny /applications/[app-id]/[attempt-id]/sql src
deny /applications/[app-id]/[attempt-id]/streaming/statistics src
